# Create fake DOIs (Digital Object Identifiers)

Create fake DOIs (Digital Object Identifiers)

## Usage

``` r
ch_doi(n = 1)
```

## Arguments

- n:

  (integer) number of things to get, any non-negative integer

## See also

[DOIProvider](https://docs.ropensci.org/charlatan/reference/DOIProvider.md)

## Examples

``` r
ch_doi()
#> [1] "10.19904/36844-33253-243"
ch_doi(10)
```
